stumbles.quote: Today, `--skip-quoted` blanks table cells alongside blockquotes and italics.
stumbles.why: `--skip-quoted` is never introduced or related to the new flag. It's unclear whether it still blanks tables, whether it is unchanged, or how it interacts with `--skip-tables`. The opening says the new flag excludes tables 'without suppressing blockquotes or italics', but the text never says what `--skip-quoted` does when the two flags are combined.

stumbles.quote: Drafts that intentionally quote bad prose in italics still need italic text checked while skipping tables.
stumbles.why: The reason is only implied. The text never says that `--skip-quoted` would hide those italics, so a reader can't tell why the new flag is needed rather than the old one.

stumbles.quote: blanks any line that starts with `|` before scanning
stumbles.why: This is a line-prefix rule, but the opening speaks of 'Markdown tables' and the Reason speaks of 'table cells'. Indented tables, or table rows that don't begin with `|`, would not be matched. The text doesn't say whether that is acceptable.

stumbles.quote: Two judges labelled 58 of those 63 table hits as legitimate numbers and labels
stumbles.why: The 'judges' are never explained: humans or models, and by what criteria. The 41 posts and the 300 hits are also unexplained. The numbers support the change, but a reader can't evaluate them.

stumbles.quote: adds two test cases for `--skip-tables`, and the full suite of 212 tests passes
stumbles.why: It is unclear whether 212 includes the two new tests. The text also doesn't say what the new tests cover.

point: The PR adds a `--skip-tables` flag to `declaude_lint.py` that blanks lines starting with `|`, so table hits (mostly false positives) are ignored while italics and blockquotes are still scanned, and it bumps the version to 0.13.3.
